surface: dashboard/ (single Flask-served page, vanilla JS modules, no build step)

decisions.direction: Retro financial terminal on paper, after conway.ai: warm paper ground, ink type, one electric accent, hairline-ruled ledger grid, square corners.

tokens.note: Series pairs pass dataviz validate_palette.js on their own surface; dark is its own validated steps, not a flip.

decisions.type: Aktiv Grotesk for everything (tabular figures for numbers); Inter Tight as the free fallback. Aktiv files are local-only (gitignored) pending a web license.
decisions.motion: anime.js v4: staggered reveals, count-up numbers, row staggers, helix morphs. All disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
components: Pointillist DotField hero background: halftone field, pointer repel, scroll kick (original)
FiberHelix hero visual, three topologies (inspired by 21st.dev Helix Chrono Matrix)
Seven-segment LCD total PnL (adapted from 21st.dev Segmented LCD Number Ticker)
decisions.charts: One axis per chart (capital at risk is its own chart, never a second y-axis); legend with current values; crosshair tooltips.
